claims.statement: Anchor account 7675/8093BA230 sent 8 transfers to 8 distinct counterparties between 2022-09-06 and 2022-09-08, each counterparty receiving exactly one transfer.
Each outgoing transfer in USD, CAD, or INR is paired with a same-timestamp self-transfer where the account pays Euros and receives the foreign currency, indicating currency conversion.
The account received only one incoming transfer (83.45 EUR from 8093B9E70) during its lifetime, while the total outgoing paid amounts are large across four currencies.
All 8 counterparties are new, with first and last transfer dates matching the alert window, consistent with one-time payments to multiple suppliers.

findings.narrative: The fan-out alert on account 7675/8093BA230 reflects a legitimate multi-currency payment operation. The account converts a Euro balance into USD, CAD, and INR via same-timestamp self-transfers, then sends each converted amount to a distinct counterparty. All 8 counterparties appear only once, consistent with one-time payments to international suppliers. The only incoming funds are a trivial 83.45 EUR cash deposit; the large Euro amounts used for conversion (totalling ~94,484 EUR) were pre-existing. No layering, return flows, or structuring are present. The fan-out shape is fully explained by ordinary business activity.
